verdict.rationale: Superset publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 'Superset API' spec for programmatic access to its agent-orchestration platform, and a runtime probe retrieved it. The same surface is fronted by a TypeScript SDK and a hosted MCP server, both live and documented, so the product itself offers a documented public API. The earlier 404s were only on docs-subdomain paths; the spec lives on the api subdomain, so they do not contradict this. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the REST API directly, and evidence of per-endpoint reference documentation depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
